The '''Hive Traffic Control''', abbreviated as '''HTC''', was a structure built atop the [[Hive]], which itself was located on the roof of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]].
